46.table workflow_edges: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_EDGES ( WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL , EDGE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , POSITION INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ( POSITION >= 0 ) , FROM_NODE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , TO_NODE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , PORT_TYPE TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( PORT_TYPE IN ( 'text' , 'image' , 'file' ) ) , BRANCH TEXT CHECK ( BRANCH IS NULL OR BRANCH IN ( 'yes' , 'no' ) ) , CHECK ( FROM_NODE_ID <> TO_NODE_ID ) , PRIMARY KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , EDGE_ID ) , FOREIGN KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , FROM_NODE_ID ) REFERENCES WORKFLOW_NODES ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , FOREIGN KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , TO_NODE_ID ) REFERENCES WORKFLOW_NODES ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE )
46.table workflow_nodes: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_NODES ( WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES WORKFLOWS ( WORKFLOW_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , NODE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , POSITION INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ( POSITION >= 0 ) , KIND TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( KIND IN ( 'text' , 'prompt' , 'asset' , 'llm' , 'agent' , 'image' , 'trigger' , 'condition' , 'approval' , 'output' , 'note' , 'shape' ) ) , AGENT_ID TEXT , X REAL NOT NULL , Y REAL NOT NULL , WIDTH REAL , HEIGHT REAL , FONT REAL , LOCKED INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ( LOCKED IN ( 0 , 1 ) ) , FIELDS_JSON TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( JSON_VALID ( FIELDS_JSON ) ) , SCHEDULE_JSON TEXT CHECK ( SCHEDULE_JSON IS NULL OR ( KIND = 'trigger' AND JSON_VALID ( SCHEDULE_JSON ) ) ) , PRIMARY KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) )
46.table workflow_output_deliveries: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_DELIVERIES ( STEP_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES WORKFLOW_STEPS ( STEP_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONNECTION_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES PROJECTION_MESSAGING_CONNECTIONS ( CONNECTION_ID ) , PLACE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , TEXT TEXT NOT NULL , STATUS TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( STATUS IN ( 'pending' , 'sending' , 'sent' , 'failed' , 'uncertain' ) ) , REASON TEXT , ATTEMPTS INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ( ATTEMPTS >= 0 ) , SENT_AT TEXT , CREATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL )
46.table workflow_runs: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_RUNS ( RUN_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES WORKFLOWS ( WORKFLOW_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , NUMBER INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ( NUMBER >= 1 ) , TRIGGER_NODE_ID TEXT , FROM_NODE_ID TEXT , SOURCE TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( SOURCE IN ( 'manual' , 'schedule' , 'webhook' ) ) , SCHEDULED_FOR TEXT , IDEMPOTENCY_KEY TEXT NOT NULL , GRAPH_REVISION INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ( GRAPH_REVISION >= 0 ) , GRAPH_JSON TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( JSON_VALID ( GRAPH_JSON ) ) , PAYLOAD TEXT , STATUS TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( STATUS IN ( 'running' , 'approval' , 'stopping' , 'done' , 'failed' , 'stopped' ) ) , ERROR TEXT , STARTED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , ENDED_AT TEXT , UPDATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UNIQUE ( WORKFLOW_ID , NUMBER ) , UNIQUE ( WORKFLOW_ID , IDEMPOTENCY_KEY ) )
46.table workflow_steps: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_STEPS ( STEP_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES WORKFLOWS ( WORKFLOW_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , RUN_ID TEXT REFERENCES WORKFLOW_RUNS ( RUN_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , NODE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , ATTEMPT INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ( ATTEMPT >= 1 ) , REQUEST_ID TEXT NOT NULL , KIND TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( KIND IN ( 'prompt' , 'asset' , 'llm' , 'agent' , 'image' , 'trigger' , 'condition' , 'approval' , 'output' ) ) , AGENT_ID TEXT , STATUS TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( STATUS IN ( 'running' , 'approval' , 'done' , 'failed' , 'stopped' , 'skipped' ) ) , DELIVERY_ID TEXT , TURN_ID TEXT , INPUT TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' , OUTPUT TEXT , BRANCH TEXT CHECK ( BRANCH IS NULL OR BRANCH IN ( 'yes' , 'no' ) ) , ERROR TEXT , STARTED_AT TEXT , ENDED_AT TEXT , CREATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UNIQUE ( WORKFLOW_ID , REQUEST_ID ) )
46.table workflow_trigger_webhooks: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_TRIGGER_WEBHOOKS ( WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL , NODE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , ROUTE_ID TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE , SECRET_CIPHERTEXT TEXT NOT NULL , URL TEXT , CREATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , PRIMARY KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) , FOREIGN KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) REFERENCES WORKFLOW_TRIGGERS ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE )
46.table workflow_triggers: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_TRIGGERS ( WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL , NODE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , KIND TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( KIND IN ( 'manual' , 'schedule' , 'webhook' ) ) , TIMEZONE TEXT , SCHEDULE_JSON TEXT CHECK ( SCHEDULE_JSON IS NULL OR JSON_VALID ( SCHEDULE_JSON ) ) , NEXT_DUE_AT TEXT , UPDATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , PRIMARY KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) , FOREIGN KEY ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) REFERENCES WORKFLOW_NODES ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE )
46.table workflow_versions: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_VERSIONS ( VERSION_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES WORKFLOWS ( WORKFLOW_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , GRAPH_REVISION INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ( GRAPH_REVISION >= 0 ) , KIND TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( KIND IN ( 'auto' , 'restore' , 'run' ) ) , GRAPH_JSON TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( JSON_VALID ( GRAPH_JSON ) ) , CREATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL )
46.table workflow_webhook_receipts: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOW_WEBHOOK_RECEIPTS ( RECEIPT_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , WORKFLOW_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES WORKFLOWS ( WORKFLOW_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , NODE_ID TEXT NOT NULL , DELIVERY_ID TEXT NOT NULL , STATUS TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( STATUS IN ( 'started' , 'ignored' ) ) , REASON TEXT CHECK ( REASON IS NULL OR REASON IN ( 'busy' , 'refused' ) ) , RUN_ID TEXT , RECEIVED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UNIQUE ( WORKFLOW_ID , NODE_ID , DELIVERY_ID ) )
46.table workflows: CREATE TABLE WORKFLOWS ( WORKFLOW_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , TITLE TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( LENGTH ( TITLE ) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 ) , GRAPH_REVISION INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ( GRAPH_REVISION >= 0 ) , STROKES_JSON TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK ( JSON_VALID ( STROKES_JSON ) ) , NEXT_RUN_NUMBER INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ( NEXT_RUN_NUMBER >= 1 ) , CREATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL )

47.index agent_threads_agent: CREATE INDEX AGENT_THREADS_AGENT ON PROJECTION_AGENT_THREADS ( AGENT_ID , CREATED_AT DESC )
47.index agent_threads_open: CREATE INDEX AGENT_THREADS_OPEN ON PROJECTION_AGENT_THREADS ( AGENT_ID , UPDATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ARCHIVED_AT IS NULL
47.table projection_agent_threads: CREATE TABLE PROJECTION_AGENT_THREADS ( THREAD_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES PROJECTION_THREADS ( THREAD_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , AGENT_ID TEXT NOT NULL , LEGACY_TASK_ID TEXT UNIQUE , ORIGIN TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( ORIGIN IN ( 'user' , 'agent' ) ) , TITLE TEXT NOT NULL , TITLE_SOURCE TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( TITLE_SOURCE IN ( 'auto' , 'agent' , 'user' ) ) , OUTCOME TEXT CHECK ( OUTCOME IS NULL OR OUTCOME IN ( 'completed' , 'failed' , 'interrupted' ) ) , ERROR TEXT , CREATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , ARCHIVED_AT TEXT , LAST_EVENT_SEQUENCE INTEGER NOT NULL )
